text.card: A red giant 2,289 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.96 solar masses and 10.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,766 K at its surface.
